tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rig byed ma'i gnad yig gsal byed bzhugs so// swasti/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos dmar po skor gsum la/ rig byed ma'i skor la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rnam gzhag bzhugs kyang man ngag thugs rtsis su mdzad pa ni phyi sgrub la gsum 'di yin kyang kun mkhyen lnga pas phyi sgrub 'di nang sgrub du ngos 'dzin mdzad na'ang / rang gi go tshod ni phyi sgrub yin pa'i yig cha rnams la bltas pas gsal zhing / brgyud par ldan pa'i bla ma las man ngag yongs rdzogs thob phyir nyams len bla ma gong ma'i phyi sgrub kyi yig cha gang gi steng nas byas kyang 'gal ba mi 'dug kyang mkhas rmongs kun gyi go bde bar tshar chen gyi gnad yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun yig thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs yul sngar phan yi ger med kyang bla ma'i gsung las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad nyi la rdo rje 'chang dmar po bsgoms pas sku gsung thugs la skyabs yul tshang tshul spyi 'gre bzhin/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du zhes sogs ngag nas brjod na legs pas de'i ngag 'don sgrub yig bzhin la/ sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sbyar/ bdag bskyed la mi go ba ci yang med/ rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa bzlas gong du bya ba bla ma'i phyag len dang / thun mtshams su bya ba gzhung gi dngos bstan yin pas gang bde byas la gong ma ltar na bzlas pa rdzogs nas gtor bsngo/ 'og ma ltar na rang byin rlabs rdzogs nas gtor bsngo/ de ltar thun bzhi'i tshul gyis zla drug 'bum phrag bcu na bzlas pas mtshan ma thung ba ni dus grangs mtshan bsnyen te zhes bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas bcu cha'i sbyin bsreg kyang tshar chen gyi gsung bzhin cha cha lag dang bcas pa 'di yin pas ji ltar nyams su len tshul la/ gnad yig las bsnyen sgrub las gsum skabs gcig du gsung pa las gzhi'i bsnyen dang / sgrub sgrub bsnyen gyi dbye ba mi 'dug kyang gsang sngags spyi 'gre thog mar gzhi'i bsnyen bya tshul ni/

dpyid zla ra ba'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad sogs la sgrub khang yid dang mthun par cha gsum yid ches par btang / bgegs gtor dor ba'i rjes su sngags yungs sngags gul gyis brab bdug drag sngags bzla sogs spyi 'gre bya/ cha gsum 'di rgyud sde 'og ma nas gsungs kyang gong mar sbyar ba 'gal ba med tshul ni bsnyen yig mang po la brtags pas shes/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyai rdo rje sor bzhag 'on kyang bdag bskyed kyi tshogs zhing sogs la chu gnyis sngon 'gro mdzad pa ni rgyas bsdus kyi khyad tsam las don la 'gal ba med pas chu bzhi byung na mchog du legs bya/ dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bsnyen pa 'di sgrub bsnyen nam mkha' gso'i bsnyen pa yin pas gzhung bzhin nyams su blangs pas rtags thon na sgrub pa mi dgos kyang bsnyen pas ji bzhin ma sgrub tshe sgrub pa bya tshul la rang nyid nus ldan dang / ling 'khor gnyis yig cha zhal gsal zur 'debs bcas kyi shin tu go bar yod pas 'bri ma dgos/ bdag bskyed bsnyen dus sor bzhag la bzlas pa nyung ngu byas/ rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa bzlas gong du mi bya bar bzlas pa rdzogs nas mdun bskyed sgrub tshul/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa lis bsangs/ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po brgyad ces pa nas rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed sor bzhag la bdag nyid dor/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs mdun bskyed la bstim/ chu bzhi chu gnyis gang rung gis mchod/ nang mchod byin brlabs mi dgos par ku ru kulle maṇḍal oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das ma snang / rje btsun ma zhes pa nas yid 'phrog cing dbang du byed pa'i rje btsun ma dngos su gyur/ ces gsal btab la bzlas par bya'o/ /thun 'phro gcod pa dang bcom ldan 'das 'di zhes bya ba'i thog drangs brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad rang ngam che ge mo zhes bya ba'i dbang du bsdus par byin gyi brlab tu gsol/

zhes brjod la rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa bsgom/ gtor ma byin rlabs gtor mgron spyan drangs mdun bskyed la bstim/ gtor 'bul mchod bstod rdzogs nas tsandan gyi maṇḍal tshom bu lnga pa 'bul/ 'di nyi zla dor ba'i ri gling yin nam snyam yang yig cha dang gsung mthun gsal ba ma rnyed/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas rang ngam gzhan gang yin de'i khams gsum dbang du 'dus shing mchog thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub par byin brlab tu gsol/ na bza' dmar po bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs 'bul rnams kyai rdor bzhin las/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ byas kyang mi 'gal/ rig byed lha mo'i sku la gsol byas kyang yong / mtshan sngags kyi mthar wasatra sbyar/ rgyas pa na/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /me tog bsil ba'i phreng ba rnams/ /rgyal yum nyid la mchod par 'bul/ /ku ru kulle maṇḍal sa pa ra wa ra padma ra ga puṣpe pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes me tog dmar po gtor/ bsdu na maṇḍal sa gzhi spos byug na bza' dang me tog gnyis sngar tsam gyis chog rgyas bsdus gong ltar maṇḍal ni me tog 'bul ba'i bar la grangs bzung la bdun nyer gcig brgya stong sogs ci 'grub byas pa'i mthar 'phro gcod pa na bzlas pa'i mjug gi 'dod gsol sbyar/ yig brgya dang mjug chog rnams bsnyen pa bzhin bya ba ni sgrub pa'o/ /las sbyor gyi skabs bsam gtan kho nas las la sbyor ba ni bsnyen sgrub gnyis gong bzhin la bzlas pa nyung ngu re byas/ sgrub pa'i bzlas pa rdzogs nas bsam gtan kho na'i las sbyor gyi dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ thog mar rlung sbyor ci 'grub dang de nas dmigs pa de dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas sngags brgya stong sogs ci nus bzlas/ thun gyi mthar de'i dmigs pa bzhag la rang byin rlabs bsgoms nas bkra shis kyi bar sgrub pa bzhin/

yang 'og nas 'byung ba'i las sbyor dang spel nas nyams su len tshe bsam gtan kho na'i las sbyor gyi bzlas pa ci 'grub byas mthar brub khung bsangs pa nas bzung me la gdung ba'i bar nyams su blang g.yon pa'i mthe bong pho nya mor bsam pa ni bka' bstod pho nya mo'i yi ger gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin mo der bsgom mo/ /las sbyor 'di dag re re grub kyang kun tshang nyams su blang na 'khyun che bas de bzhin bya/ rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa ni me'i gdung ba'i bar gyi las sbyor tshang la nyams su blang na de rjes bya/ thog mar mtshod len pa'i skabs 'gug 'dren gyi dmigs sngar thun 'phro gcod mtshams dang de rjes kyi las sbyor rnams 'phral nas nyams su len tshe zangs khab dbang bsdud la zhag gsum bdun sogs so/ /mda' gzhu dang me'i gdung ba'ang des rigs 'gre sbyor na so so rdzogs mtshams rang byin rlabs nas bkra shis kyi bar gong bzhin nyams su blangs/ sbyin bsreg gi dbang bskur ni tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge zur gsal bzhin dang / rdzas kyi dbang sdud dang las sbyor 'grol tshul ni sgrub thabs nag 'gros gsal byed dang bcas pas rtogs nus so/ /bkras rnam pa'i skor dang tshogs bdag 'dod rgyal gnyis la slar tshe ring nad med bsam pa 'grub pa zhig byung na rang lugs kyi bstan 'dzin rjes 'brang dang bcas pa la phan pa'i gsal byed nyung gsal khyer bde re bris tshe dris lan zur pa 'dra ba mi dgos 'dra bas blor 'brangs 'tshal/ bkra shis khams gsum dbang bsdus shog maṅga laṃ// //sa chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rig byed ma'i gnad yig gsal byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
